weekend_note: Dry and pleasant: Saturday is 77 with about a 1 percent rain chance, Sunday 78 and 3 percent, and nothing wet in sight through Halloween weekend. Picks: free SevilleStock/Hippie Fest and the Glass & Ceramic Pumpkin Patch sale Saturday, Boo at the Zoo both days, Hunter Hayes at the fair Saturday night, the Ice Flyers (indoors) Saturday at 7:05, and the Temptations Revue Sunday. Storm recovery from Isaias is ongoing, so double-check smaller events before heading out.

coverage_note: Written Saturday, Oct 24. Weather: Fox Weather supplied highs, lows and rain chances through Oct 30 (it did not list Oct 24, so 1 percent comes from Weather Underground/Almanac readings); Oct 31 uses Weather Underground temperatures with a rough 10 percent rain estimate. Events draw on Local Pulse, Must Do Pensacola, the WEAR fair lineup and Allevents trunk-or-treat listings. NorthEscambia.com blocked automated reading (robots), so its fall festival list and Walnut Hill Heritage Festival could not be confirmed; Gonzalez, Beulah, Molino and Cantonment items are carried over from earlier checks and not reconfirmed. Fox10, WKRG, Visit Pensacola, the downtown calendar, PensacolaBeach.com and the Saenger/Blue Wahoos sites were not opened this run. No restaurant openings or closings were newly confirmed; Pelican and Casa Luvia remain unconfirmed. News is limited to WEAR headlines I read. The fair's Oct 30 act is Colt Ford in the official lineup but LOCASH in one local calendar.
